claims: FUN_0011ed90 walks a serialized geometry section whose top-level table uses 0x34-byte records and takes two separate u16 header counts from each record at offsets +0x1c and +0x28.

FUN_0011ed90 reads each per-group header's count from +2 and flags from +0, then computes aligned payload positions using a mandatory 6-byte plane, optional 20-byte plane for flag 0x800, 4-byte plane, an extra 4-byte plane when the third u16 is not 0xffff, and optional 4-byte planes for flags 0x40 and 0x80.

FUN_0012d4b8 loads and parses a .PS2 resource with FUN_0011ed90, resolves named entries SKYDOME and MINI_SKYDOME, and in its later object-processing loop passes three float parameters to FUN_00113aa8, which invokes VU0 vcallms immediate 0x4d (byte VMA 0x268). This supports a parsed-object-to-VU0-transform linkage at object/float level.

The available evidence does not establish that any particular six-byte or four-byte serialized geometry plane contains vertices, indices, normals, texture references, or that those exact plane bytes are submitted to VIF1/VU1.

evidence.text: Pinned static-export.json instruction records for FUN_0011ed90: 0011ee90 lhu v1,0x1c(a0); 0011ee98 lhu v0,0x28(a0); 0011ee9c addiu a0,a0,0x34; loop at 0011eea0-0011eea8 sums both halfword counts. Group A at 0011ef38 lhu v0,0x1c(v1); group header read at 0011ef64 lhu a2,0x2(s2), 0011ef68 lhu v0,0(s2); output pointers at 0011ef4c sw s2,0x20(v1) and 0011ef54 sw s1,0x24(v1); advances for 6*n and conditional planes based on flags 0x800,0x40,0x80 and third halfword sentinel at 0011ef64-0011eff4; calls FUN_00121420 at 0011eff8; group B at 0011f044 lhu v1,0x28(a0); writes pointer fields +0x2c/+0x30 at 0011f05c/0011f064. It also calls FUN_00123908 at 0011ee30 and FUN_0022ba30 at 0011ee3c.

tools/ps2_sections.py geometry(): reads a u32 table count at next_section.offset, then count records with stride 0x34. For each record it reads unsigned little-endian halfwords at offsets +0x1c and +0x28 and sums header counts. header(): 8-byte prefix decoded as four u16 values; count is second word, flags is first. For each header the extraction records a 6-byte-per-count plane, optional 20-byte plane when flags&0x800, 4-byte plane, extra 4-byte plane unless third==0xffff, optional 4-byte planes for flags 0x40 and 0x80; every plane is aligned to 16 bytes.

Static C export FUN_0012d4b8: formats a path at call 0012d558 and calls FUN_0011ed90 at 0012d568, stores the returned parsed object at context offset 0x188, looks up the names SKYDOME and MINI_SKYDOME through FUN_00124cb8 at 0012d57c/0012d590, and later loops over object records. At 0012dd70-0012dd88 it loads float arguments from the current record and calls FUN_00113aa8. Static C export FUN_00113aa8 invokes _vcallms(0x268) for nonzero param_1, param_2, param_3 and stores packed components into its output buffer.

Model 3DDATA/CARS/49COUPE.PS2;1 has SHA-256 62e3de6688791e6af88d65bebe7156ee2d1f1ec83911316cafddf3173259f381 and length 1,146,656. Existing exact-EOF result maps the next-section record table to offset 933,940, count 39, stride 52 (0x34); geometry headers start 935,968; payload starts 938,880; loader68 section starts 1,143,232. Offline ps2_sections parse of first geometry header found offset 935,968, count 64, flags 0xC008, third 0; the following 6-byte plane is offset 938,880 count 64 size 384; next 4-byte plane offset 939,264 count 64 size 256; third 4-byte plane offset 939,520 count 64 size 256.

Prior exact static overlay evidence establishes that VU0 vcallms immediate values are multiplied by 8 to get byte VMAs; immediate 0x4d therefore targets byte VMA 0x268. This establishes address mapping only, not matrix or geometry semantics.
